title: Navigating the Risks: A Survey of Security, Privacy, and Ethics Threats in LLM-Based Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying methodologies such as embedding-based metrics (calculating vector distances between neutral words like professions and identity-related words like gender pronouns) and multimodal evaluation datasets like VisoGender.
Reviewing approaches that use probability-based metrics (evaluating pseudo-log likelihoods of masked tokens) and output-based toxicity classifiers to detect discrimination.
Surveying the literature on generative biases where language models exhibit partisan or political favoritism in unstructured text outputs.
Examining datasets like WinoQueer that use unmasked sentence pairs to test the model-assigned likelihoods of biased versus unbiased statements concerning the LGBTQ+ community.

Reviewing comprehensive benchmarks (e.g., StereoSet, CrowS-Pairs, BBQ, TrustGPT) that evaluate systemic bias across various social groups using text completion, multiple-choice question-answering, and toxicity prompting.
